title: Gabbi Garcia on Khalil Ramos' leading man era: 'Proud na proud ako'
summary: As one of the most well-known celebrity couples of their generation, Gabbi Garcia and Khalil Ramos have kept it real both on and off camera. In an interview with the media during an endorsement…

blocks.text: As one of the most well-known celebrity couples of their generation, Gabbi Garcia and Khalil Ramos have kept it real both on and off camera.
In an interview with the media during an endorsement launch, Gabbi shared how proud and happy she is about Khalil’s latest film, “Saving Cherry.”

“Of course, proud na proud ako. And si Khalil naman, I have no doubts about that guy. If other people tell me, like, ‘Uy, ang galing ni Khalil, ang bait niya. He is the best leading man,’ I have nothing but praise for him,” Gabbi said.
Admitting that she has yet to watch the film because of her busy schedule, Gabbi said she is nevertheless happy to see other people recognize Khalil’s talent and appreciate him as an actor.
For Gabbi, it is especially fulfilling to see Khalil receive the kind of praise she has long believed he deserves.
“Super proud ako sa kanya and walang question dun. I'm happy that I'm able to share him with other people kasi he really is a good guy,” Gabbi added.

Despite working on different projects and alongside both new and longtime co-stars, Gabbi and Khalil always find ways to support and complement each other. One example was when Khalil served as Gabbi’s personal photographer during the media conference for “The Voice Kids.”

“Actually, medyo nakakahiya yun kasi makikita siya ng mga tao na inuutusan ko siya. Wala siyang ayos that time kasi pack up na siya galing shoot, wala akong na-book na photog and need ko gumawa ng content,” she said.
According to Gabbi, Khalil even woke up at 8 a.m. just to accompany her to the press conference.
“Sabi ko sa kanya, sorry, bub, wala talaga ako na-book, so gumising talaga siya ng 8 a.m. para samahan ako,” Gabbi added.
After almost a decade together, Gabbi described their relationship as quiet but secure.
“Very supportive siya, and hindi kasi siya maingay na tao. Our love is not loud, it's quiet but secure,” she added.
